items.headline: Bond traders flag $70B of 'shadow' credit backstops Nvidia and Broadcom are extending to AI buildouts
items.note: Off-balance-sheet residual-value guarantees from Nvidia and Broadcom on AI debt deals aren't yet drawn, but rating agencies won't rule out being called on them in a downturn, understating true chipmaker leverage.

items.headline: BofA cuts Broadcom's credit outlook to Marketweight on hidden leverage in its XPV financing platform
items.note: A sell-side credit desk downgrade tied directly to the Blackstone/Apollo-backed XPV SPV, which could carry up to $370B in senior debt and exposes Broadcom to residual-value guarantees as large as $42B in stress scenarios.
